lines.en: label day28:
scene newponytail1
: Sensei, can we please hurry up?!
lines.zh: : Sensei，能不能快点啊？！

lines.en: : Maya is all alone in the cafeteria and I'm worried about her cleaning the place out before I can get my lunch!
lines.zh: : Maya 一个人在食堂，我担心她会趁我拿到午饭前把那儿扫荡一空！

lines.en: : Well, you should have thought about that before nearly burning the classroom down.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你差点把教室烧了之前就该想到这点。

lines.en: : Come on! What kind of best friend would I even be if I let her put that many extra calories into her tiny body?!
lines.zh: : 拜托！我要是任由她那小小的身体里塞进那么多额外的卡路里，我还算什么好朋友啊？！

lines.en: : The kind that, and forgive me for repeating myself, {i}nearly burned the classroom down a few minutes ago.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就是{i}几分钟前差点把教室烧了{/i}的那种——请原谅我重复一遍。

lines.en: scene newponytail2
: I already told you that was an accident!
lines.zh: : 我都说了那是个意外！

lines.en: : None of this ever would have happened if they didn’t make those burner things so hard to use!
lines.zh: : 要不是他们把那个什么本生灯做得这么难用，这一切根本不会发生！

lines.en: : You literally just have to turn a knob. That's it.
lines.zh: : 你只要转一下旋钮就行了。就这样。

lines.en: : It’s a tough knob, okay?! You wouldn’t get it because you don’t have tiny girl fingers!
lines.zh: : 那个旋钮很紧好吗？！你不会懂的，因为你又没有女孩子细细的手指！

lines.en: As you may have heard, Ami nearly burned down the classroom today after getting into a fight with a Bunsen burner.
lines.zh: 你可能已经听说了，Ami 今天跟一个本生灯干了一架，差点把教室烧了。

lines.en: Sure, it may be my fault for allowing her to play with one unsupervised, but that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 当然，我让她在没人看着的情况下玩那玩意儿，可能是我的错，不过那不是重点。

lines.en: The fact of the matter is, she now needs to help me clean up the remnants of the fire before the custodial staff shows up at the end of the day and I lose my job.
lines.zh: 事实是，她现在必须帮我清理火灾的残骸，赶在保洁人员下班前出现、害我丢掉工作之前。

lines.en: scene newponytail3
: Ugh...I know I shouldn’t be freaking out. It was my fault for not paying attention...
lines.zh: : 呃……我知道我不该这么抓狂。是我没注意才搞成这样的……

lines.en: : You're not trying to guilt me into letting you leave now, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是想用愧疚感逼我现在放你走吧？

lines.en: scene newponytail4
: Me? Of course not...Why would I ever even try something as-
lines.zh: : 我？当然不是……我干嘛要做那种——

lines.en: : You can go to the cafeteria once we're done cleaning and not a second earlier.
lines.zh: : 等我们打扫完你才能去食堂，一秒都不能早。

lines.en: scene newponytail2
: Ahhh! But who knows what could be happening to Maya within that time?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！可这段时间里谁知道 Maya 会遭遇什么？！

lines.en: : Oh, come on. I'm sure she'll be fine...
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。我肯定她不会有事的……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene lunch1
scene lunch2
: Why are you so fuckin’ weird?
lines.zh: : 你怎么他妈这么怪？

lines.en: : I'm...sorry?
lines.zh: : 那个……抱歉？

lines.en: : You heard me. Why are you so fuckin’ weird?
lines.zh: : 你听见了。你怎么他妈这么怪？

lines.en: : You’re always just...there. You know?
lines.zh: : 你总是就……在那儿。你懂吗？

lines.en: : That...is an unfortunate side effect of my existence, yes.
lines.zh: : 那……确实是我存在所带来的一个不幸副作用。

lines.en: scene lunch3
{i}Ahh...the[school] cafeteria...One of youth’s most dangerous battlefields.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}啊……[school]的食堂……青春最危险的战场之一。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If you're one of the lucky ones who have never had to spend a period like this alone, you can never truly comprehend what it means to be lonely!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果你是那种幸运儿，从来没试过这样一节课都独自度过，那你永远无法真正理解什么叫孤独！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The thing is, that girl with the ponytail right there? Well, a simple lunch alone means nothing to her.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}问题是，那边那个扎马尾的女孩？对她来说，一个人吃顿简单的午饭根本算不了什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For her, loneliness means something different.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}对她而言，孤独意味着别的东西。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Something much bigger.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}某种大得多的东西。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But that’s something you're not ready to hear about yet!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过那件事，你现在还没准备好听！{/i}

lines.en: scene lunch2
: What’s your deal anyway?
lines.zh: : 你到底是什么来头？

lines.en: : My deal?
lines.zh: : 我的来头？

lines.en: : Yeah...you an ally? Or are you just another bitch who'll wind up on my shit list after we're done here today?
lines.zh: : 对……你是自己人？还是又一个等我们今天聊完就会上我黑名单的婊子？

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I understand what type of {i}ally{/i} you're trying to equate me to.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定你想把我等同于哪一类{i}「自己人」{/i}。

lines.en: : So, chances are, I am going to wind up on your list.
lines.zh: : 所以，我大概还是会进你的名单。

lines.en: : So what you're telling me is you're a pussy?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，你是个怂包？

lines.en: scene lunch3r
: I...don't think so? Maybe?
lines.zh: : 我……应该不是吧？也许？

lines.en: : What I'm askin' is if you're one of those people who will try to keep yourself from gettin' fucked over and all that bullshit.
lines.zh: : 我问的是，你是不是那种会拼命不让自己被坑的、净搞些有的没的的人。

lines.en: : I don't like hangin' around people who don't stand up for themselves, is all.
lines.zh: : 我就是不喜欢跟不为自己出头的人混在一起，就这样。

lines.en: : But...what does that have to do with being an ally? What would standing up for myself make me an ally {i}of?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是……这跟「自己人」有什么关系？为自己出头又能让我成为{i}谁的{/i}自己人？

lines.en: scene lunch3r2
: You know...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : You'd be an ally of...yourself. And shit.
lines.zh: : 你会成为……你自己的自己人。之类的。

lines.en: scene lunch6
: I’m so confused...
lines.zh: : 我好困惑……

lines.en: : Hey, Ponytail.
lines.zh: : 喂，马尾妹。

lines.en: : That is not my name.
lines.zh: : 那不是我的名字。

lines.en: : Oh, please. Like I give a fuck what your actual name is.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我他妈才不在乎你真名叫什么。

lines.en: : I’ve got a question for you.
lines.zh: : 我有个问题要问你。

lines.en: : I will do my best to answer it in a way that will not compel you to hit me.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量用一种不会让你想揍我的方式来回答。

lines.en: scene lunch5
: What do you think of our teacher? You hate his guts too, right?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们老师怎么样？你也恨死他了对吧？

lines.en: : You ain't like those other two girls you're always hangin' around. I can tell that much.
lines.zh: : 你跟那两个老跟你混在一起的女生不一样。这点我看得出来。

lines.en: : You are correct. I am very much not like either one of them.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我跟她们俩任何一个都大不相同。

lines.en: : In terms of our teacher- he is utterly revolting and thinking about him for extended periods of time makes me want to vomit.
lines.zh: : 至于我们的老师——他令人作呕至极，长时间想着他会让我想吐。

lines.en: scene lunch8
: Ha! I knew there was somebody else on the same page as me. Fuckin' finally.
lines.zh: : 哈！我就知道还有人跟我一个鼻孔出气。他妈的，终于。

lines.en: : Was beginning to think everyone here was just trying to fuck him.
lines.zh: : 我都开始觉得这儿所有人只想跟他上床了。

lines.en: : Nope. Couldn't be me.
lines.zh: : 不。我可不会。

lines.en: : I can’t fuckin' believe that guy sometimes, you know?
lines.zh: : 有时候我真他妈受不了那家伙，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Like, it was barely a week ago that I caught him wandering the streets at night like some kind of...lost puppy.
lines.zh: : 就说，不到一个星期前，我撞见他大半夜在街上晃荡，活像一只……迷路的小狗。

lines.en: : It was fuckin’ creepy, dude. He looked like he was gonna kill somebody. I’m lucky I escaped with my life.
lines.zh: : 那画面他妈瘆人得很，老兄。他看起来像是准备要杀谁一样。我能活着逃掉算走运了。

lines.en: scene lunch9
: That’s...certainly odd. Even by his standards- which only barely exist from what I've seen thus far.
lines.zh: : 那……确实很怪。即便以他的标准来看——而据我目前所见，他那个标准也几乎等于不存在。

lines.en: : Yeah, it was {i}odd{/i} as shit. Real creep, that guy is. I can’t even believe-
lines.zh: : 是啊，{i}怪{/i}得要死。那家伙就是个变态。我都不敢相信——

lines.en: scene lunch7
: Wait, but what were you doing out that late?
lines.zh: : 等等，可你那么晚在外面干什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : If you caught him wandering around in the middle of the night, wouldn't that make {i}you{/i} weird as well?
lines.zh: : 如果{i}你{/i}撞见他半夜在外面晃，那你不也一样很怪吗？

lines.en: : I'm just trying to understand your logic. Frankly, I know less about you than everyone else combined, so...
lines.zh: : 我只是想理解你的逻辑。坦白说，我对你了解的程度，比对其他所有人加起来还少，所以……

lines.en: : What if you're just weird too? Or something.
lines.zh: : 万一你其实也很怪呢？之类的。

lines.en: scene lunch7r
: You tryin’ to fuckin’ accuse me of something, Ponytail? You think I’m out late because I’m up to trouble, is that what this is?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是在指控我什么吗，马尾妹？你觉得我那么晚在外面是因为在搞事，是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : That wasn't what I meant to imply. But-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。不过——

lines.en: scene lunch13
: Save your fucking breath. No point explaining something that doesn’t {i}need{/i} any explaining.
lines.zh: : 省省你的唾沫吧。根本不{i}需要{/i}解释的事，解释也没意义。

lines.en: : Shame. I was startin' to think you might be different in a {i}good{/i} way. Turns out you're just as pathetic as the rest of them.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我刚还以为你可能是那种「{i}不一样{/i}的怪」，结果是跟其他人都一样可悲。

lines.en: : I think {i}pathetic{/i} might be a bit of a stretch.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}「可悲」{/i}可能说得有点过了。

lines.en: : It ain't a stretch at all, Ponytail. You think I ain't seeing through that fuckin' dead-fish persona of yours? How you act all weird and quiet and shit just so you can get attention?
lines.zh: : 一点都不过分，马尾妹。你以为我看不穿你那副死鱼一样的德性？装得又怪又安静什么的，就为了博关注？

lines.en: : I feel like you are gravely misinterpreting my personality right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你此刻严重误读了我的性格。

lines.en: : Doubt it. Girls like you ain't got anything interesting about 'em at all. You're probably just some random ass Kumon-mi transplant trying to fit in in her own fucked up, ass backwards way.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么想。像你这种女生一点有意思的地方都没有。你大概就是个随随便便搬到 Kumon-mi 来的外地人，用自己那套乱七八糟、倒行逆施的方式想融入而已。

lines.en: : Yeah...where the fuck did you even come from anyway? I've lived here my whole life and I haven't even seen you until this year.
lines.zh: : 对啊……你他妈到底从哪儿冒出来的？我在这儿住了一辈子，今年之前根本没见过你。

lines.en: : This is a very hard conversation to keep up with so I am just going to eat my lunch if that is okay with you.
lines.zh: : 这段对话实在太难跟上了，所以如果你不介意的话，我就先吃我的午饭了。

lines.en: : The fuck was stopping you in the first place? Did I tell you not to eat?
lines.zh: : 那他妈一开始是谁拦着你了？我有叫你别吃吗？

lines.en: scene lunch14
: No, it's just...
lines.zh: : 不是，只是……

lines.en: : The fuck are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在等什么？

lines.en: scene lunch15
: It just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It feels weird with you staring at me.
lines.zh: : 你这么盯着我看，感觉很怪。

lines.en: scene lunch16
: Okay, that’s it. I’m getting out of here.
lines.zh: : 好，够了。我走了。

lines.en: : For a second, I thought we might’ve had a chance to get along on account of our mutual hatred for the teacher...but you’re just too fuckin’ weird for me.
lines.zh: : 有那么一瞬间，我还以为看在我们都恨老师的份上，我俩能处得来……可你对我来说实在太他妈怪了。

lines.en: : Oh no. Please don't go. If you leave, who will watch me eat?
lines.zh: : 哦不。请别走。你要是走了，谁来盯着我吃饭？

lines.en: scene lunch17
: Oh, get bent. Come talk to me if you ever decide to stop being a fuckin’ sketchball.
lines.zh: : 哦，滚蛋吧。哪天你决定不再当个神经兮兮的怪人了，再来跟我说话。

lines.en: : Goodbye, Yumi. I apologize for being a sketchball.
lines.zh: : 再见，Yumi。我为我是个神经兮兮的怪人向你道歉。

lines.en: : I said get bent, damn it!
lines.zh: : 我说了滚蛋，该死！

lines.en: scene lunch18
: I forgot chopsticks.
lines.zh: : 我忘拿筷子了。

lines.en: scene black
scene newponytail5
: Ugh, finally done...
lines.zh: : 呃，终于弄完了……

lines.en: : Who’d have ever thought cleaning up after a fire would be so difficult?
lines.zh: : 谁能想到火灾后的清理会这么费劲？

lines.en: : Probably...most people.
lines.zh: : 大概……大多数人吧。

lines.en: : Hopefully Maya didn’t gain 800lbs while I wasn’t there to supervise her...
lines.zh: : 希望我不在旁边看着的这段时间，Maya 没有胖上 800 磅……

lines.en: : You know, I wanted to say something before, but I don't think friends are supposed to be counting calories for one another.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我之前就想说了，我觉得朋友之间不该替对方数卡路里。

lines.en: scene newponytail6
: Most friends, probably not. But Maya is no normal friend, Sensei. The amount that girl is able to eat is one of the greatest mysteries of this world.
lines.zh: : 大多数朋友大概不会。可 Maya 不是普通的朋友，Sensei。那丫头的食量是这个世界最大的谜团之一。

lines.en: : She's even smaller than me, yet she can fit ten times as much in her mouth.
lines.zh: : 她比我个子还小，却能在嘴里塞下十倍的东西。

lines.en: : Well, that's not a sentence I'm going to misinterpret at all. Thanks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这句话我可一点都不会误解。谢了啊，Ami。

lines.en: : Huh? I don't get it.
lines.zh: : 啊？我没听懂。

lines.en: : And that's exactly what I like about you.
lines.zh: : 而这正是我喜欢你的地方。

lines.en: scene newponytail7
: I don't know what you mean by that, but it got you to say you like me so that's fine by me!
lines.zh: : 我不知道你什么意思，不过反正让你说出了喜欢我，那就没问题啦！

lines.en: : Now, come on! Maya should still be in the cafeteria and if we hurry, we might be able to save her from destroying her mysterious black hole of a body!
lines.zh: : 现在，快走！Maya 应该还在食堂，要是快点，我们说不定还能把她从「用自己那个黑洞般的身体自我毁灭」里救出来！

lines.en: scene black
I follow Ami to the cafeteria and it's no surprise that I’m once again shrugged off by Maya as soon as we arrive.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Ami 去了食堂，不出所料，我们一到，Maya 就又一次把我晾在一边。

lines.en: Coincidentally, the cafeteria was also out of food when we got there.
lines.zh: 巧的是，我们到那儿的时候，食堂的吃的也卖光了。

lines.en: In the end, Ami and I had to go the rest of the school day without eating...
lines.zh: 最后，我和 Ami 只能饿着肚子熬过剩下的半天……
